props.title: Milliohm Meter 16502
paragraphs: Milliohm meter with a wide measurement range and a pulsed test mode.

props.body:

- Wide measurement range: 0.001mΩ ~ 1.9999MΩ
- Pulsed test mode (thermal EMF reduction)
